name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Harald Vilimsky
part_text:
The European Parliament is being asked to lift the legal protection from prosecution that Harald Vilimsky, an Austrian member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Austrian prosecutors want to charge him over money spent in 2013, before he became a member. They say he used party funds to pay for a door and lock at his private address, costing the party 9,434 euros. The Parliament's legal affairs committee recommends lifting his protection, and the Parliament has decided to do so.

- **What changes:** Vilimsky loses his protection from prosecution, so Austrian prosecutors can pursue the case against him.
- **Who it affects:** Harald Vilimsky, a member of the European Parliament from Austria, and the Austrian party FPÖ.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament's President sends the decision to the Austrian authorities and to Vilimsky.
